title: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam highlighting the spirit of selfless service and dedication
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has said that the continuous flow of rivers teaches us how we can utilise our capabilities for the welfare of humanity. He noted that the spirit of selfless service, dedication and benevolence gives a new direction to the nation.
The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam-
“जीवनं स्वं परार्थाय नित्यं यच्छत मानवाः।
इति सन्देशमाख्यातुं समुद्रं यान्ति निम्नगाः॥”
The Subhashitam conveys that human beings, dedicate your lives to the service and welfare of others. Just as rivers flow ceaselessly and selflessly, sustaining countless lives with their waters before ultimately merging into the ocean, so should we devote our time, abilities and resources to the well-being of others. The true purpose and fulfilment of human life lie in selfless service, compassion and the welfare of all.
The Prime Minister wrote on X;
“नदियों का अविरल प्रवाह सिखाता है कि हम किस प्रकार अपने सामर्थ्य का उपयोग मानवता की भलाई के लिए कर सकते हैं। निःस्वार्थ सेवा, समर्पण और परोपकार की यही भावना राष्ट्र को नई दिशा देती है।
जीवनं स्वं परार्थाय नित्यं यच्छत मानवाः।
इति सन्देशमाख्यातुं समुद्रं यान्ति निम्नगाः॥”
नदियों का अविरल प्रवाह सिखाता है कि हम किस प्रकार अपने सामर्थ्य का उपयोग मानवता की भलाई के लिए कर सकते हैं। निःस्वार्थ सेवा, समर्पण और परोपकार की यही भावना राष्ट्र को नई दिशा देती है। जीवनं स्वं परार्थाय नित्यं यच्छत मानवाः। इति सन्देशमाख्यातुं समुद्रं यान्ति निम्नगाः॥ pic.twitter.com/wiaXL3jabi — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) August 21, 2026

enrichment.summary: The Prime Minister Narendra Modi shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam on social media that likens the ceaseless flow of rivers to selfless human service, emphasizing dedication and benevolence for humanity's welfare. He noted this spirit of selfless service can give a new direction to the nation. The post was made via X (formerly Twitter) on 21 August 2026.
enrichment.context: This release is a routine social media post by the Prime Minister sharing an inspirational Sanskrit verse (Subhashitam), a genre of moral/philosophical couplets often invoked in Indian public discourse to convey values like service, dharma, and duty. Such posts are part of the PMO's regular practice of highlighting cultural and spiritual heritage, often timed around no specific event, though sometimes linked to festivals or occasions. It does not announce any policy, scheme, or governmental decision, and carries no administrative or legal weight.
